prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-pilot-02
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 9d6b17ca775e17ef
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback read via reg_dat_do returned 0xff (idle ~0) instead of 0xa5, showing recv_buf_valid never latched correct recv_buf_data. Reset leaves recv_state in 1, the half-bit wait gated by 2*recv_divcnt > cfg_divider, instead of idle state 0 that waits for !ser_rx. Without start-bit gating the receiver advances to state 2 after half a divider period and mis-samples the frame, so the byte is lost.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 9d6b17ca775e17ef in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
